title: Transported small strict-local section maps
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism and y:Spec Ω→Y a geometric point. Let C be the coordinate-ring colimit over a small representative affine pointed category [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let q:Spec C→Y be its structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. The existing canonical final-functor colimit isomorphism e:C≅O^sh identifies Spec(e.inv) followed by strictLocalizationToBase with q. Define the small-model leg Spec C×_Y X→V×_Y X as the base change of Spec(e.inv) followed by the official leg [lem-weil-pbc-sets-pushforward-stalk-strict-henselization]. Its second projection is the projection to X and its first projection is the original small spectrum-cone leg followed by Spec Γ(V)≅V. Define its graph section into the pullback to Spec C×_Y X using this leg and the identity.

source.place: Tag 03Q9, affine pointed-neighbourhood replacement and the inverse limit X×_Y Spec(O^sh); canonical comparison under the choice of a small representative category

proof.text: The final-functor colimit comparison commutes with every coprojection by Functor.Final.ι_colimitIso_inv. Apply Spec and the original structural-map characterization to prove the comparison is over Y. Base change this map and compose with the official strictHenselizationBaseChangeMap. Pullback projection identities and the same coprojection equation give its two projections; its graph is pullback.lift with second component identity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q9, compatibility of the chosen small affine-neighbourhood limit presentation
